rationale: Despite gapping down on a slight Q3 earnings miss, ALV has recovered strongly from its $110.00 low to trade at 87.8% of its daily range, well above both session VWAP ($113.67) and the 5-minute 9-EMA ($115.78). However, the current bid-ask spread of $0.24 (20.7 bps) represents over half of a 5-minute ATR ($0.4714), creating prohibitive execution friction with only 74 minutes left in the session and a tight remaining daily loss budget. Therefore, neither chasing the extended long recovery nor fading the upward momentum offers a favorable risk-to-reward profile.
